description: Empirical power-rating lookup: tabulated overall efficiency vs flow ratio q=Q/Q_design at design net head; P = eta(q)*rho*g*Q*H_net/1000 kW (low-head Kaplan/Francis)

H_design.note: Design net head (gross minus 5% penstock loss)

P_rated.note: Rated power output at design point

head_loss_fraction.note: Penstock head loss fraction (already in H_design)

q_ratio.note: Flow ratio Q/Q_design (Kaplan turbine has flat curve)

eta_overall.note: Overall efficiency at each flow ratio

source: Penche (1998), Layman's Guidebook on How to Develop a Small Hydro Site; IEC 60041; reuses EC129 F1a parameters
